definition_en: toward the source side of a system
definition_es: hacia el lado de la fuente de un sistema
example_en: Check the upstream protective device first.

definition_en: toward the load side of a system
definition_es: hacia el lado de carga de un sistema
example_en: The downstream panel is supplied by this feeder.

definition_en: side of equipment connected toward the electrical source
definition_es: lado del equipo conectado hacia la fuente
example_en: Measure the line-side voltage as required by the procedure.

definition_en: side of equipment connected toward the electrical load
definition_es: lado del equipo conectado hacia la carga
example_en: Verify load-side voltage after the device closes.

definition_en: mandatory wording commonly used in codes and standards
definition_es: palabra de carácter obligatorio usada en códigos y normas

definition_en: word indicating that one option or condition is excluded
definition_es: palabra que indica que una opción o condición se excluye
example_en: Which of the following is correct EXCEPT one?

definition_es: valor más bajo permitido o requerido
example_en: Select the minimum value that satisfies the requirement.
Do not exceed the maximum rating.

definition_en: phrase indicating an action must be completed before electrical power is applied
definition_es: frase que indica que una acción debe completarse antes de aplicar energía
example_en: Verify the connections before energizing the equipment.

definition_en: phrase referring to actions required after a repair has been completed
definition_es: frase que se refiere a acciones requeridas después de una reparación

definition_en: used to ask for the best action or choice in the stated conditions
definition_es: usado para pedir la mejor acción u opción dadas las condiciones
example_en: What is the most appropriate next action?

definition_en: planned next step selected after evaluating a condition or fault
definition_es: siguiente paso elegido después de evaluar una condición o falla
example_en: Determine the course of action from the test results.

definition_en: meeting the stated acceptable limits or requirements
definition_es: cumpliendo los límites o requisitos establecidos
example_en: Confirm the measured value is within specification.

definition_en: not meeting the stated acceptable limits or requirements
definition_es: sin cumplir los límites o requisitos establecidos
